title: The Algebra of Algebraic Data Types
summary: A London Haskell talk on the algebra of algebraic data types, showing how sum and product types behave like arithmetic. It frames types as numbers obeying algebraic laws.
why: Cited as the author's own talk and a way to go deeper on type algebra, with a note that the audio is rough at the start.

quote.text: Real types are numbers that obey type algebra, which C/Java/Go have no idea exists.
